**Language:**

MarkEditor ships machine-drafted translations that still need a native
speaker's review. If you speak this language, a review of the ~60 short
strings takes about 10 minutes. The steps are in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, under
"Reviewing a draft".

- [ ] Interface strings (`Resources/Localizable.xcstrings`)
- [ ] Document type name (`Resources/InfoPlist.xcstrings`)
- [ ] Checked in the running app (menus, Settings, status bar)

Found something that reads wrong or unnatural? Note it here, or fix it
directly in a pull request.
